0022600149.text: The Hawks (3-3, 1st in the Southeast, 6th in the East) visit the 1-4 Pelicans (13th in the West) after going 2-1 on the road, while New Orleans is 1-2 at home and enters on a one-game winning streak. Atlanta has won both of the teams' meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently a 117-100 win in Atlanta, and the two teams have not yet met this season. Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture) are out for the Hawks, while Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise) are out for the Pelicans.
